definitions: To recall or bring back to mind information or events that were previously known but have been forgotten or are unclear.
To review information in order to remember it more clearly.
examples: I need to refresh my memory on the details of the project.
She refreshed her memory by looking at her notes.
Let me refresh your memory about what we discussed.
pastTenses: refreshed one's memory (simple past), refreshed one's memory (present perfect), refreshed one's memory (past perfect)
